## The Complete Persepolis (Persepolis, #1-4)

### By Marjane Satrapi

#### Rating: 2 stars

Image

An autobiography in graphic-novel form, this was a rather odd book. The author is Iranian and the great-granddaughter of the last emperor and the book tells the story of living during the Islamic Revolution and the odd schizophrenic society that developed after it, as well as her time in Austria for four years.

I wasn’t hugely impressed by this. I don’t think the graphic novel format worked and that normal prose would have told her story better. It just didn’t add anything to the telling, and it also meant that each incident (the focus of a chapter) had to be told in sketch form (no pun intended) rather than in any great depth. An interesting experiment, but I don’t think it worked. I also didn’t feel much sympathy for the author for a good chunk of it either.

The Complete Persepolis is, in one volume, Marjane Satrapi’s best-selling, 
internationally-acclaimed memoir-in-comic-strips, telling the story of 
Satrapi’s unforgettable childhood and coming of age within a large and 
loving family in Tehran during the Islamic Revolution. The book explores 
the contradictions between private life and public life in a country 
plagued by political upheaval; Satrapi’s high school years in Vienna 
facing the trials of adolescence far from her family; her homecoming—
both sweet and terrible; and, finally, her self-imposed exile from her 
beloved homeland. It is the chronicle of a girlhood and adolescence at 
once outrageous and familiar, a young life entwined with the history of 
her country, yet filled with the universal trials and joys of growing up.

BRIEF BIOGRAPHY OF GERALD DURRELL
Stephanides' books on aquatic life was still a leading and
guiding piece of research as of the early 21st century. It's easy
to see how Gerald Durrell's time on Corfu influenced his later
efforts in zoo keeping. He revolutionized how animals were
kept in captivity, specifically promoting habitats for captive
animals that mimic their natural habitats as closely as possible,
something that occupies much of Gerry's time throughout the
novel and is now an extremely common zoo practice.

Nejedná se o fikci, a jakkoli figurují jednotlivé kapitoly spíš odděleně, všechny spolu souvisí. Dohromady tak vytváří komplexní obraz pěti let života na Korfu.

Na úrovni jednotlivých povídek jsou patrné zápletky (např. nezdařený lovecký výlet sourozenců),258 v některých se Durrell zaměřuje na téměř čistý popis přírody. Častá je přítomnost více zápletek, přičemž jedna vede k druhé, anebo kombinace čistého popisu (rostlin, moře, zvířat) a děje. Příkladem kombinované zápletky je povídka, ve které se rodina s přáteli vydala na výlet lodí, přičemž nejdřív řešila konflikt s vesničany na jiném ostrově a poté porouchanou loď bez možnosti zavolat si pomoc.259 Povídkou bez zápletky je například jedna z prvních v první knize. Durrell v ní líčí, jak se jako dítě seznamoval se zahradou kolem vily a pozoroval jemu do té doby neznámý středomořský hmyz.260

Struktura a dynamika textu je proměnlivá v závislosti na tom, o čem daná povídka nebo její úsek zrovna pojednává. Na úrovni celých knih a celkového vyprávění nadřazená zápletka chybí. Povídky spolu souvisí, ale nejsou kauzální. Napříč knihami neexistuje pojící dějová linka, pouze linka života na ostrově.
